fix.description: Root cause: _consistency_pillar (backend health_score.py) was purely live-data driven with no floor, so a fresh user with zero logs scored 0 (empty red bar) while the other 5 pillars all cushion to a quiz/neutral baseline. Fix: no logs in the 30d window -> neutral 50; otherwise blend live score toward 50 by an observed-days ramp (full trust ~14 active days). Verified on prod: fresh quiz-taker with zero logs now shows Consistency 50 (composite 78 STRONG), not 0. Unit test added.

judge.note: Prod-verified end-to-end: fresh quiz-taker with zero logs now computes Consistency 50 (screenshot shows half-filled bar, composite 78 STRONG) vs the old punishing 0; matches the module cold-start contract; unit test added and green.

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Health Score: the Consistency pillar has NO cold-start fallback, so essentially every brand-new user sees "Consistency 0" (a full red/empty bar) on the celebratory quiz-reveal screen and on /health-score, and the composite score is dragged down ~15 pts on day one. This contradicts both the calm-premium UX and the health_score module docstring, which promises: "Cold-start (no live data) -> blend with quiz answers where possible, else 50 neutral."

ROOT CAUSE (backend app/services/health_score.py):
Five of the six pillars cushion a no-live-data user:
- _nutrition_pillar / _activity_pillar: live_score=None -> return the quiz-section average.
- _recovery_pillar: no sleep data -> parts=[(quiz_score,1.0)] -> quiz score.
- _body_comp_pillar: no height/weight -> quiz weight_history score.
- _lifestyle_pillar: no quiz -> returns 50 neutral.
But _consistency_pillar (health_score.py:384-411) is PURELY live-data-driven with no floor: daily_count / meal_count / workout_count / weight_count all come from the last 30 days of logs; with zero logs coverage=0, workout_cov=0, weight_cov=0 -> score = round(0.5*0+0.3*0+0.2*0) = 0. It returns 0, NOT the documented 50 neutral. Consistency is the lone pillar with no quiz/neutral cold-start blend.

MANIFESTATION: A user who onboards and takes the baseline quiz before logging anything (the quiz is offered right from Profile / the dashboard "Take the baseline quiz" CTA) submits the quiz -> POST /health-score/quiz -> compute_health_score runs synchronously against zero logs -> consistency=0. HealthScoreReveal.tsx renders pillar "Consistency" with value 0 and an empty bar, on the same screen that fires confetti for a good score. Even a lightly-active user (2 logged days) gets coverage~7, workout_cov 0, weight_cov 0 -> score ~3, still a near-empty red bar. Weighted: consistency contributes 15%*0 = 0 instead of the ~7.5 a neutral 50 would give, so the revealed baseline is unfairly low.

EXPECTED: on cold start (no/low logging history) Consistency should fall back to a neutral baseline (50) like the other pillars, per the module contract, rather than reading a punishing 0.
ACTUAL: Consistency = 0 (full red bar) for every fresh quiz taker, lowering the composite ~15 pts.

REPRO: fresh account -> complete onboarding -> open /health-quiz and answer all 23 questions -> Finish. On the reveal screen (and /health-score pillar breakdown) Consistency shows 0 with an empty bar while every other pillar shows a reasonable value.

FIX: give _consistency_pillar a cold-start cushion consistent with the other pillars, e.g. when there is no logging history in the window (max(daily_count,meal_count,workout_count,weight_count)==0) return 50 neutral, or blend the live coverage toward 50 until enough days exist to score it fairly.

issues.description: [suggestion] Quick-add "Recent meals" row for one-tap re-logging of frequently eaten foods. Problem: meal logging (FoodSearchSheet) requires a full search+select+qty flow every time, even for the same dal/roti/protein-shake a user eats daily — the highest-frequency action in the app has the highest friction, which is a known churn driver in nutrition trackers (MyFitnessPal/Cronometer both ship "recent" and "favorites" as their #1 speed feature). Evidence: grepped src/pages/_components/nutrition + components/plan-builder — no favorites/recent/quick-add/log-again surface exists anywhere in the logging flow today. Proposed v1: backend endpoint returning the user’s last 8 distinct logged foods (query existing meal-log table, group by food_id, order by last-logged desc) + a "Recent" chip row atop FoodSearchSheet; tapping re-logs the same food/qty at current time via the existing log-meal endpoint (no new write path). Effort: ~1 backend endpoint (S) + ~1 FE component insert (S), no schema change — half-day.

issues.description: [suggestion] Injury-aware exercise substitution when a plan is paused for injury. Problem: PlanPauseScreen (src/pages/PlanPauseScreen.tsx) already has an "Injury" pause reason but only stores it as a label — no body-part capture and no downstream effect, so on resume the workout plan generator/coach can re-serve the exact movement that caused the injury (e.g. shoulder press after a shoulder injury). Evidence: REASONS array has injury as a flat enum value with no follow-up field; workout-plan generation and AI coach have no injury-exclusion input anywhere in the codebase. Comparable apps (Fitbod, Future) ask which body part and auto-avoid loading it. V1 scope: when reason=injury, show one extra step "Which area?" (shoulder/knee/back/wrist/ankle/other) + optional note; store on the pause record; on resume, pass the flagged body part(s) to the workout-plan builder/coach system prompt to exclude/soften exercises targeting that area for the first 1-2 weeks back, with a banner reminding the user to clear it manually if resolved sooner. Effort: ~1-2 days (1 new field + storage, 1 builder-prompt condition, 1 UI step).
